# GitHub Copilot instructions

See `AGENTS.md` in the repository root for the full project conventions.

## Language policy

Write everything that goes *into the code* in **English**: commit messages,
code comments, docstrings, identifiers (variables, functions, classes,
files), and in-repo docs (`README`, `docs/`, config comments, log/error
messages), plus PR titles and descriptions.

Chat replies to the maintainer may stay in Russian — the English rule
applies to committed artifacts, not to conversation.
